blocks.text: The word "every" in time expressions answering the question "how often" is rendered as follows: каждый день (понедельник, вторник, четверг) — masc. (acc.); каждое утро (воскресенье) — neut. (acc.); каждую среду (пятницу, субботу) — fem. (acc.)

The word "all" in time expressions answering the question "how long" is rendered as follows: весь день (год, месяц, вторник) — masc. (accus.); всё утро (воскресенье, лето) — neut.; все дни (годы) — plur.; всю неделю (зиму, осень, ночь) — fem.

The preposition в + acc. is used to indicate the time of the day (*Собрание начинается в три часа.*), the day of the week (*Я был там в пятницу.*), and how frequently something occurs (*Я хожу в штаб два раза в день.*). The preposition на + acc. is used to indicate the length of time one expects to stay some place: *Он приехал сюда на два дня.*
From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lessons 22, 37, 73.

The exercises are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. The word in brackets is the dictionary form of the missing word.

exercises.q: Враг атаковал ___ (весь день).
exercises.prompt: The enemy kept up their attack all day.
exercises.why: «весь» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: У нас пять уроков англа в ___ (неделя).
exercises.prompt: We have five English classes a week.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Вы приютите нас на ___ (одна ночь)?
exercises.prompt: Will you put us up for one night?
exercises.why: «на» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я вернусь через ___ (месяц).
exercises.prompt: I'll be back in a month.
exercises.why: «через» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: За ___ (неделя) он постарел на несколько лет.
exercises.prompt: He aged several years in the course of a week.
exercises.why: «за» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Он уехал два-три ___ (день) назад.
exercises.prompt: He left here two or three days ago.
exercises.why: «… назад» (ago): accusative, or genitive after a number — неделю назад, три дня назад. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Do you wash your dog every day?
exercises.why: «каждый» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I went to bed at midnight.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom doesn't want to have oatmeal for breakfast.
exercises.ru: Том не хочет есть на ___ овсянку.
exercises.why: «на» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I quit after a week.
exercises.why: «через» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I read half a page in an hour.
exercises.why: «за» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Этот запах навеял воспоминания об одной ночи несколько ___ (годы) назад.
exercises.prompt: The smell brought back memories of a night some years before.
exercises.why: «… назад» (ago): accusative, or genitive after a number — неделю назад, три дня назад. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я ___ (вся ночь) проворочалась с боку на бок.
exercises.prompt: I tossed and turned all night.
exercises.why: «весь» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Телестанции вещают 24 часа в ___ (сутки).
exercises.prompt: Television stations broadcast 24 hours a day.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: На ___ (следующий день) Изабела вернулась домой.
exercises.prompt: The next day, Isabela came back home.
exercises.why: «на» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Через ___ (год) родился Поль.
exercises.prompt: One year later, Paul was born.
exercises.why: «через» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Встряхнитесь! Вы за ___ (вся неделя) ничего не сделали.
exercises.prompt: Snap out of it! You haven't done a thing all week.
exercises.why: «за» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Мэрилин Монро умерла 33 ___ (год) назад.
exercises.prompt: It has been 33 years since Marilyn Monroe died.
exercises.why: «… назад» (ago): accusative, or genitive after a number — неделю назад, три дня назад. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I straighten my hair every morning.
exercises.why: «каждый» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: On Monday, she gave birth to her first child.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
